---
name: Hardware or packaging compatibility
about: Propose a profile or report an installation issue
---

Models/versions only: headset, controller family, GPU/driver, Linux/desktop and package commit.

What works, what fails, and which tests establish it? Is this a clean install, upgrade or rollback?

Do not include serials, account names, private paths, tokens, complete system logs or unit calibration. Other WMR hardware is untested until demonstrated.
